title.zh: Binance Will Add 5 bStocks Tokenized Securities as Collateral Asset - 2026-10-21
title.en: Binance Will Add 5 bStocks Tokenized Securities as Collateral Asset - 2026-10-21

current_state.zh: Binance will accept five bStocks tokenized securities — BOTB, BRKBB, KSTRB, TMFB and VSTB — as eligible collateral in Cross Margin, Portfolio Margin and Portfolio Margin Pro from 2026-10-21 12:00 UTC, and will make the corresponding bStocks pairs available for margin trading.
